results.title: Bank holiday today: Check if SBI, HDFC, ICICI branches are open or closed on Saturday, 26 September
results.description: Bank holiday today, 26 September: SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank branches are closed as it is the fourth Saturday. Public sector banks and RRBs will operate on Sunday, 27 September, ahead of the proposed nationwide bank strike from September 28-30.
